cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three knocks, same as you. Treasure hunters' greeting. The map's brought us to wake this wall; I'll knock louder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking whether it's hollow. Solid. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Solid, yes. We were sent to hear it in darkness. I'll put the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine; listen now.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies B's knocking as a greeting; A3 covers B2's solid-wall correction with a listening mission, and A5 turns B4's failure into breath training.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's solid wall and low light both enter A3's new action; B4's only sound becomes A5's controlled silence.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants a useful wall test and usable light; B4 reports the actual listening result instead of endorsing A's invented purpose.

heightening.evidence: A5 acts on B4's failed listening by holding breath, a different secret goal rather than just repeating the first.

specificity.evidence: A1 states treasure, map and wall; B2 explains the real knocking test and dwindling light.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 asks B to listen during the breath hold; it serves the claimed test rather than explaining the comic mechanism.
